_status: FIXTURE-READY — all spec values populated, synthetic deal (no live DB row)
_synthetic_note: No live DB deal exists for this spec. Layer 1 / Layer 2 DB checks and Layer 3 API checks are SKIPPED in the validate script; spec coherence is checked instead. Behavioral validation lives in apps/worker/src/lib/financial-facts/__tests__/synthetic-actuals-fixture.test.ts.
_coverage_rationale: REF-DEAL-5: Clean historical actuals + forward forecast in same XLSX workbook. Tests the system's ability to correctly distinguish historical actuals (high confidence) from forward projections (medium), select actuals as current_state.revenue, and not let future-year rows contaminate current-state. This is the scenario the existing 4 deals never fully exercise: DealDecision is proforma-only; WebMax is a single-year scenario; StackFactor has projections but no actuals; Qredible is deck-only. No deal in the set has both verifiable historical actuals AND a multi-year forecast in the same workbook.
_failure_modes_targeted: Compiler promoting a future-year XLSX row over the most-recent-actual row (period confusion)
Extraction treating 'FY2025 Actual' and 'FY2026 Budget' identically instead of tagging period_type differently
Revenue regression: actuals row suppressed by noise guard because its period_label matches a guard pattern
Burn rate computed from budget/forecast total expenses instead of actual total expenses — overstating efficiency
Scale confusion when actuals are in whole dollars and forecast is also whole dollars (denomination should not produce sub-$10K rows)
Gross-margin contradiction: actuals show 45% but forecast shows 70% — compiler must not blend them
_onboarding_status: PHASE-4-COMPLETE — fixture spec populated, Vitest behavioral tests passing

financials._note: Synthetic fixture: SynthCo P&L XLSX, fiscal year ending December 31. FY2023 and FY2024 are audited actuals; FY2025 and FY2026 are board-approved budgets. All values in whole USD (not $000s). Key assertion: FY2024 Actual revenue ($2,400,000) must win over FY2025 Budget ($4,200,000) in current_state resolution.

revenue.evidence: SynthCo P&L XLSX — 'Total Revenue', column 'FY2024 Actual': $2,400,000

burn_rate.evidence: SynthCo P&L XLSX — 'Total Operating Expenses', column 'FY2024 Actual': $2,280,000 / 12 = $190,000/month

gross_margin_pct.evidence: SynthCo P&L XLSX — 'Gross Margin %', column 'FY2024 Actual': 45%

validation._note: With _synthetic=true, the validate script runs spec coherence checks only (no DB/API). Behavioral assertions live in synthetic-actuals-fixture.test.ts.

extraction_checks.note: Must be FY2024 Actual ($2,400,000), not FY2025 Budget ($4,200,000)
Monthly burn from FY2024 Actual opex ($2,280,000 / 12). Must not use FY2025 Budget opex ($300K/month).
FY2024 Actual gross margin 45%. Must not blend with FY2025 Budget 70%.

noise_checks.label: Budget revenue not tagged as high-confidence current_state fact
noise_checks.sql_filter: metric_key = 'revenue' AND period_label ILIKE '%budget%' AND confidence = 'high'
noise_checks.description: Budget rows must not receive 'high' confidence — actuals must win the confidence race. Fix 15.

noise_checks.label: Scale confusion: sub-$10K revenue facts from XLSX
noise_checks.description: XLSX is in whole dollars. Any revenue fact under $10K would indicate denomination confusion ($000s misread).

report_checks.label: current_state.revenue must be FY2024 Actual ($2.4M)
report_checks.note: Fails if compiler selects FY2025 Budget ($4.2M) instead of FY2024 Actual

report_checks.label: current_state.revenue source_kind must be xlsx
report_checks.note: Revenue source must not be 'deck' — XLSX actuals take priority

report_checks.label: current_state.burn_rate must be from actuals (~$190K/month)
report_checks.note: Must not use FY2025 Budget burn ($300K/month)
